verified_facts.text: Zenova has treatment rooms, a Couples Spa Suite, a full-service salon and the Co-Ed Via Aquae.

verified_facts.text: The Ceremonial Sauna is inspired by Europe's Aufguss saunas and offers guided rituals led by a traditional Sauna-Meister, with sound therapy and aromas.

verified_facts.text: The spa's Snow Room is kept at 10 to 14 degrees Fahrenheit and gives off alpine forest scents; the hotel calls it the region's first authentic Snow Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the region's first authentic Snow Room, this transportive and custom room maintains a crisp 10 to 14°F, while emitting soothing alpine forest scents.

verified_facts.text: The Sensory Shower combines hot and cold therapy, chromotherapy, aromatherapy and oxygenation.
verified_facts.excerpt: A dynamic experience delivering a powerful combination of hot and cold therapy, chromotherapy, aromatherapy and oxygenation.

verified_facts.text: The Vitality Pool is Zenova's signature therapeutic pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Zenova’s signature therapeutic pool warms the body, stimulating the lymphatic system.

verified_facts.text: Zenova Spa & Wellness is open exclusively to resort guests and club members.
